name: Turbine Engine
description: An on/off signal controls engine startup. The throttle input takes a standard value between -1 and 1 and controls the forward and backward force of connected components. The engine's maximum power output is split between connected components.
shortDescription: Turbine engine that can be connected to powered components.

logicNodes.label: Starter
logicNodes.description: Increases the engine RPS using electrical power to start up the engine.

logicNodes.label: Throttle
logicNodes.description: Standard value between 0 and 1 that controls the throttle of the engine.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: The rps supplied by the engine for inputting to other components.
